title: Concept: Dependency linked as a symlink to a local directory
description: package.json declares a `link:` dependency, which installs a symlink instead of a package, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Nothing is copied into the artifact, so the dependency resolves to a directory that may not exist or may differ on any other machine.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Nothing is copied into the artifact, so the dependency resolves to a directory that may not exist or may differ on any other machine.
